import QleisliKernel.PhaseLayout

/-! Exact interference laws used by subsequent hierarchical rules.
Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -/

namespace QleisliKernel.Interference

abbrev Bits := Nat → Bool

def setBit (bits : Bits) (axis : Nat) (value : Bool) : Bits :=
  fun i => if i = axis then value else bits i

@[simp] theorem setBit_same (bits : Bits) (axis : Nat) (a b : Bool) :
    setBit (setBit bits axis a) axis b = setBit bits axis b := by
  funext i
  simp [setBit]

@[simp] theorem setBit_read (bits : Bits) (axis : Nat) (value : Bool) :
    setBit bits axis value axis = value := by simp [setBit]

@[simp] theorem setBit_original (bits : Bits) (axis : Nat) :
    setBit bits axis (bits axis) = bits := by
  funext i
  simp [setBit]
  intro h
  subst i
  rfl

/-- Semantic premises, not runtime evidence that an artifact can supply. -/
structure Model (C : Type) [Lean.Grind.CommRing C] where
  halfRoot : C
  root : C
  halfRoot_square : 2 * halfRoot * halfRoot = 1
  root_period : root ^ 256 = 1

variable {C : Type} [Lean.Grind.CommRing C]

def hadamard (h : C) (axis : Nat) (amplitude : Bits → C) : Bits → C :=
  fun bits => h * (amplitude (setBit bits axis false) +
    if bits axis then -amplitude (setBit bits axis true) else amplitude (setBit bits axis true))

theorem hadamard_involution (model : Model C) (axis : Nat) (amplitude : Bits → C) :
    hadamard model.halfRoot axis (hadamard model.halfRoot axis amplitude) = amplitude := by
  funext bits
  have square := model.halfRoot_square
  cases hb : bits axis with
  | false =>
    have original : setBit bits axis false = bits := by rw [← hb]; exact setBit_original bits axis
    simp only [hadamard, setBit_same, setBit_read, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      Bool.true_eq_true, hb, original]
    grind
  | true =>
    have original : setBit bits axis true = bits := by rw [← hb]; exact setBit_original bits axis
    simp only [hadamard, setBit_same, setBit_read, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      Bool.true_eq_true, hb, original]
    grind

def diagonal (model : Model C) (terms : PhasePolynomial.Polynomial)
    (amplitude : Bits → C) : Bits → C :=
  fun bits => model.root ^ PhasePolynomial.evaluate terms bits * amplitude bits

theorem diagonal_normalize (model : Model C) (terms : PhasePolynomial.Polynomial)
    (amplitude : Bits → C) :
    diagonal model (PhasePolynomial.normalize terms) amplitude = diagonal model terms amplitude := by
  funext bits
  simp [diagonal, PhasePolynomial.normalize_sound]

inductive Gate where
  | hadamard (axis : Nat)
  | diagonal (terms : PhasePolynomial.Polynomial)
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

def applyGate (model : Model C) : Gate → (Bits → C) → (Bits → C)
  | .hadamard axis => hadamard model.halfRoot axis
  | .diagonal terms => diagonal model terms

/-- Reverse chronological stack: the head acts last. -/
def stackAction (model : Model C) (stack : List Gate) (amplitude : Bits → C) : Bits → C :=
  stack.foldr (applyGate model) amplitude

def push (stack : List Gate) (gate : Gate) : List Gate :=
  match gate, stack with
  | .hadamard axis, .hadamard previous :: rest =>
    if axis = previous then rest else gate :: stack
  | .diagonal terms, _ => .diagonal (PhasePolynomial.normalize terms) :: stack
  | _, _ => gate :: stack

theorem push_sound (model : Model C) (stack : List Gate) (gate : Gate)
    (amplitude : Bits → C) :
    stackAction model (push stack gate) amplitude =
      applyGate model gate (stackAction model stack amplitude) := by
  cases gate with
  | diagonal terms => simp [push, stackAction, applyGate, diagonal_normalize]
  | hadamard axis =>
    cases stack with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons previous rest =>
      cases previous with
      | diagonal terms => rfl
      | hadamard previous =>
        by_cases same : axis = previous
        · subst previous
          simp [push, stackAction, applyGate, hadamard_involution]
        · simp [push, same, stackAction]

def run (model : Model C) (gates : List Gate) (amplitude : Bits → C) : Bits → C :=
  gates.foldl (fun state gate => applyGate model gate state) amplitude

private theorem fold_sound (model : Model C) (gates stack : List Gate) (amplitude : Bits → C) :
    stackAction model (gates.foldl push stack) amplitude =
      run model gates (stackAction model stack amplitude) := by
  induction gates generalizing stack with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons gate rest ih => simpa [run, push_sound] using ih (push stack gate)

def normalize (gates : List Gate) : List Gate := (gates.foldl push []).reverse

theorem normalize_sound (model : Model C) (gates : List Gate) (amplitude : Bits → C) :
    run model (normalize gates) amplitude = run model gates amplitude := by
  have h := fold_sound model gates [] amplitude
  simpa [run, normalize, stackAction, List.foldl_reverse] using h

/-- Arbitrary joint amplitudes: no product-state or separability premise. -/
theorem normalize_reference (model : Model C) (gates : List Gate) {R : Type}
    (joint : Bits → R → C) (reference : R) :
    run model (normalize gates) (fun bits => joint bits reference) =
      run model gates (fun bits => joint bits reference) :=
  normalize_sound model gates (fun bits => joint bits reference)

/-- Equality from the phase/layout checker may be interpreted as weighted
basis transitions, retaining global phase and arbitrary output coordinates. -/
def liftAction (model : Model C) (action : PhaseLayout.Action)
    (continuation : Bits → C) (bits : Bits) : C :=
  let result := action ⟨bits, 0⟩
  model.root ^ result.phase * continuation result.bits

theorem checked_phase_layout (model : Model C) (definitions : List PhaseLayout.Definition)
    (entry : Nat) (required : PhaseLayout.Summary) (stats : PhaseLayout.Stats)
    (accepted : PhaseLayout.check definitions entry required = .ok stats)
    (actual : PhaseLayout.Action) (meaning : PhaseLayout.denote definitions entry = some actual) :
    liftAction model actual = liftAction model required.action := by
  have same := (PhaseLayout.check_sound definitions entry required stats accepted).1
  rw [meaning] at same
  cases Option.some.inj same
  rfl

end QleisliKernel.Interference
